cards.title: How pediatrician says connection beats tech fears
cards.body: A pediatrician argues that loss of human connection is the biggest threat to children, not AI itself. The solution is spending more time talking openly with each other rather than focusing on screen restrictions.

cards.title: The benefits of having an older sibling
cards.body: Older siblings influence younger siblings in ways parents cannot, serving as trusted role models and mentors. This relationship often becomes especially important during adolescence.

cards.title: When babies cry excessively, support parents too
cards.body: New research highlights that when babies cry excessively, parents often struggle too. Parent-focused support emerges as a key benefit alongside addressing infant distress.

cards.title: Why real paintings can look AI-generated
cards.body: A new study raises questions about what clues we trust when a painting from 1839 looks more artificial than an AI image. This has implications for how children learn to evaluate visual information.

cards.title: How family traditions bring households together
cards.body: A parent describes how a yearly tradition of making jam from their cumquat tree brings family members together after their daughter moved out. Such rituals help maintain connections across different life stages.
